summary: Comprehensive product strategy audit of the Classy application across all 13 requested domains, featuring 15 Classy-specific feature proposals (each with description, value, workflow integration, complexity, and infrastructure cost), the Top 10 Best Opportunities ranked by impact, and a complete Wave 1 execution blueprint for the Top 3 recommended features aligned with zero-cost infrastructure, rapid QR/roll-call attendance, scheduling intelligence, and parent WhatsApp receipts.
